audio: The local engine audio was silenced. The matching official-level tracks are now played by the visible YouTube IFrame player when each level starts; an internet connection is required. No music file is copied into this project.
engineChanges: Fixed 1920x1080 logical display for consistent mobile and desktop play
Rebuilt data package with silent audio
Landing collision now detects crossing a block surface between frames and snaps the player to the surface before solid-body collision handling
Rotated cube render offset also applies while falling toward a solid surface
Player renders after level objects so blocks and decorations cannot visually cover the cube.
Block landing and support use a stable axis-aligned player hitbox; gravity is suspended while grounded and restored immediately after leaving a surface.
Side collisions restore the last safe position instead of pushing the player backward or beyond the block.
Block landing candidates and top/underside support use the rotated cube bounds so visible corners can land on platforms without a false side collision.
Block contact from above or below snaps the rotated cube to the solid surface as soon as its polygon overlaps, even if a frame crossing was missed.
An overlapping cube approaching the top side of a block is resolved onto its upper surface regardless of vertical velocity, preventing lethal side-corner hits during a jump.

Cube spike collision uses the stable player hitbox instead of its rotated visual corners; blocks use axis-aligned collision to prevent artwork from striking low ceilings. Ship block contact uses the inset solid collider for clearance through narrow corridors.
Gravity portals clear the prior grounded state immediately so the cube can move away from the previous surface after gravity flips.
In inverted-gravity sections, the ceiling floor is rendered and collides as a landing surface for the cube.
Added five-block assisted platforms in clear sections of all 15 stages. Platform placement avoids overlapping existing solid blocks and hazards, and the blocks use the engine collision system.
